heading: The Crucifixion Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Crucifixion Bible crossword: Calvary, the two malefactors, the darkness over the land, and the rent veil. KJV clues from Luke 23, free on iOS.
prose: The place called Calvary, two malefactors, one on the right hand and the other on the left, and a darkness over all the earth from the sixth hour to the ninth. The Crucifixion covers Luke 23 with the other Gospels' details woven in — the crown of thorns, the title written in three languages, the vinegar, the veil of the temple rent in the midst.
It is a sober puzzle and deliberately a plain one; the clues do not embellish. The closing verse is the sentence that names the place.

clues.text: The place where they crucified him
Plaited and put on his head
With Greek and Latin, a language of the title

verseText: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
